wiki.title: Rudy Yakym
wiki.extract: Rudolph Chester Yakym III ( YAH-kim; born February 24, 1984) is an American politician and businessman who is the member of the U.S. House of Representatives representing Indiana's 2nd congressional district. He is a member of the Republican Party.
